analysis.reason: RSI가 과매도 구간 진입 후 반등 시도 중이나, SMA5(30,847)가 SMA20(31,298) 하회하며 약세 정렬 지속. ADX 24.1로 추세 형성 초기 단계이며, -DI(30.6)가 +DI(20.4) 상회로 매도 우위 지속. 5일 연속 거래량비 1.48로 급증했으나 방향성 부재. 30,040원 가격은 스윙 지지선 29,960원 상단에 위치하나, 저항선 30,570원 하단에 있어 방향성 탐색 구간.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts a rebound after entering oversold territory, but SMA5 ($30,847) remains below SMA20 ($31,298), indicating continued weak alignment. ADX at 24.1 suggests an early stage of trend formation, with -DI ($30.6) exceeding +DI ($20.4), signaling persistent selling pressure. Volume ratio at 1.48 for 5 consecutive days indicates a surge but lacks directional conviction. The price of $30,040 is above the swing support at $29,960 but below the resistance at $30,570, marking a phase of directional exploration.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($30,040) vs SMA5 ($30,847)/SMA20 ($31,298)/SMA50 ($34,445): Below short/mid-term trends, confirming weak alignment.
· Significantly lower than SMA100 ($37,595)/SMA200 ($36,379): Indicating weakened long-term trend.
· 52-week position (33.3%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (49.0→43.1): Entering oversold territory, attempting a rebound.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-179.3047→161.0457): Improving after bearish convergence, signaling bottoming.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower $25,217, Middle $31,298): Approaching lower band, with a band width of 38.86% suggesting potential volatility expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($29,960): Above Pivot S1 ($24,595) and 5-day low ($28,455).
· Swing Resistance ($30,570): Below SMA5 ($30,847), a breakout could signal a short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: Sideways, exploring directional bias.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.48x): Surge in volume, adding conviction to price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis: Accumulation phase, consider buying upon confirmation of RSI exiting oversold and MACD improvement.
